## Musik 1.13.0

- **Chillscreen:** the room from the website, with all its camera moves, now runs in the app as a full screen mode. Switch it on in Settings → Playback, then open it with the button in the big player. The record shows the cover of the song that plays.
- **Coffee mug fixed:** a real mug with rim, inner wall and handle, and soft steam instead of flat panels (website and app).
- **Visualizer in the mini player:** bars, wave or glow, in the accent colour or as a rainbow with its own speed. New sliders for sensitivity, bass, mids and highs.
- **Playback:** crossfade, the same volume for all songs, and streaming quality (automatic, low, normal, high, very high).
- **No more short silences:** the server now loads YouTube audio in 1 MB pieces, so a song no longer stops for two seconds in the middle.
- **Playlists:** preload button, "Add songs" with search, drag and drop on the PC, edit mode on the phone.
- **Library:** one row of buttons instead of three.
- **Liked songs** always on the start page.
- **Taste & mix:** choose how much of your mix comes from your own files and how much from streaming. Take songs out of your taste profile from their menu and put them back in the settings.
- **Other devices on your account:** see what plays on your PC or phone, pause it, or take it over with "Play here".
- **Discord (desktop app):** shows "Listening to Musik" with the song and a download button.
- **Liquid Glass:** clear glass instead of frosted milk, a light rim that turns with the pointer or the tilt of the phone, no colour fringes when you drag the tab bar, the mini player's progress line runs the full width, more room at the bottom.
- Search right in the title bar of the desktop app, own slim scrollbars, menus close when you press their button again, pull to refresh moves straight up.
- "Topic" from YouTube channel names no longer shows up as an artist. The setup assistant no longer asks for sources.
- **Website:** screenshots open in a viewer with zoom, the flat record is gone while the room loads, new screenshots.
